texts.preamble: Bhagat Singh vs State Of U.P. on 25 February, 2019 Author: Bachchoo Lal Bench: Bachchoo Lal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 68 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 760 of 2019 Revisionist :- Bhagat Singh Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Counsel for Revisionist :- Achyuta Nand Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Bachchoo Lal,J. Heard learned counsel for the revisionist, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
texts.facts: In brief factual matrix of the case is that Sri Mohd. Yaseen Khan (PW-1), Food Inspector, Municipal Corporation, Aligarh filed a complaint under Section 7/16 before the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 1, Aligarh with assertion that in capacity of Food Inspector on 29th June, 1991, at about 9 a.m., he found that accused Bhagat Singh was selling butter. 450 gms of butter was purchased by the Food Inspector and that was divided in three equal parts. One part was sent for its chemical examination by the public analyst, Lucknow. As per the report No. 5191 given by the public analyst the samples of the butter sent to him were having less than 80% fat contained and as such, the same was adulterated. On basis of the complaint aforesaid, the revision petitioner was tried and the contents of the application were supported by the ocular evidence given by Sri Mohd. Yaseen Khan (PW-1) and by relying upon certain documents, including the report given by the public analyst. Sri Mohd. Yaseen Khan (PW-1) while getting his testimony examined stated that on 29th June, 1991, he was working as Food Inspector at Municipal Corporation, Aligarh. At about 9 a.m., on the date aforesaid, he noticed that accused Bhagat Singh was carrying butter for sale. After disclosing identity, he purchased 450 gms of butter and for that paid a sum of Rs. 20.25 to the accused Bhagat Singh. The butter so purchased was divided in three equal parts and after necessary sampling and labelling the same was sent to the public chemical analyst. A report dated 6th August, 1991 was received by the Food Inspector from the public chemical analyst and as per that the butter was adulterated. The report then was forwarded to the Chief Medical Officer, Aligarh who granted sanction for prosecution vide the document Exhibit Ka-5. On having necessary sanction complaint was filed vide Exhibit Ka-6 before the court competent and necessary information. Suffice to state the statement aforesaid was recorded on 15th September, 1998 and on the same day this witness was subjected to cross examination by the counsel appearing on behalf of the accused. The statement given by by PW-1 during his cross examination is as follows:- Bhagat Singh vs State Of U.P. on 27 April, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160842169/ 1 "In the year 1991, I was posted in the area of Civil Lines. I had collected the sample of (illegible) Bhagat (?) Singh from Dodpur (sic.). I don't have good memory. It is an incident happened 21 years ago. I don't adequately remember (about it). I remember only it that I had collected the sample. Dodpur falls in the area of PS-Civil Lines. At the time of collecting the samples, I had not taken any public witness. The witnesses were from the staff. It was a crowded place from where I had collected the sample. The people were passing from there. The milk of cow and that of buffalo is called mixed milk. The butter made of the mixed milk is also called mixed (butter). The mixed milk contains lesser fat than average. I cannot state whether being adulterated the butter collected as sample was injurious to health or not. The butter was found adulterated in the report of the Public Analyst. My eye-sight is too weak to read. I cannot state whether prior to it, I had seen Bhagat Singh carrying and selling the butter. It is wrong to state that I had not collected the sample of the butter from Bhagat Singh and it is also wrong to state that the false proceeding had been conducted to implicate him." Appeal giving challenge to the order passed by the Trial Court came to be rejected by relying upon the same piece of evidence.
